description:
Title: Luxury Airplane

You produce airplanes.
While the base model is always the same, your customer likes to pimp their airplane with fancy interior.
You let them decide between a number of 5 different bars, the number of seats, their color, and the amount of water in the toilets of their plane (you can come up with additional stuff).
After you received the specifications you send the requirements to different teams to manufacture the parts.
E.g. manufacturing the vodka bar is done by the Russian team, the whiskey bar is manufactured by an Irish team.
After receiving the individual bits and pieces, the interior of the plane is assembled, and the plane is sent on a test flight.
During the flight you create a test protocol which is sent to you and the customer.
The plane is delivered to the customer, which has to confirm.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

  <bpmn:message id="Message_Parts" name="Manufactured parts"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Airplane" name="Airplane delivery"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Delivery confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LuxuryAirplane" name="Luxury Airplane">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Manufacturer" name="Airplane manufacturer" processRef="Process_Manufacturer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ManufacturingTeams" name="Manufacturing teams (including the Russian vodka-bar team and Irish whiskey-bar team)"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Specifications" name="Send specifications" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Start_ReceiveSpecifications" messageRef="Message_Specifications"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Requirements" name="Send requirements to manufacturing teams" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Participant_ManufacturingTeams" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Parts" name="Return manufactured parts" sourceRef="Participant_ManufacturingTeams" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts" messageRef="Message_Parts"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TestProtocol" name="Send test protocol to customer and manufacturer" sourceRef="Task_SendTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTestProtocol" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Airplane" name="Deliver airplane" sourceRef="Task_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAirplane" messageRef="Message_Airplane"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Send delivery confirmation" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Specify and receive luxury airplane" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseSpecifications" name="Choose one of five bars, seat count, color, and toilet water amount"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSpecifications" name="Send specifications" messageRef="Message_Specifications"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveTestProtocol" name="Receive test protocol" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAirplane" name="Receive airplane" messageRef="Message_Airplane"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ConfirmDelivery" name="Confirm delivery" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer" name="Delivery confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_ChooseSpecifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_ChooseSpecifications" targetRef="Task_SendSpecifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAirplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAirplane" targetRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery" targetRef="End_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Manufacturer" name="Manufacture luxury airplane" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ReceiveSpecifications" name="Specifications received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Specifications" messageRef="Message_Specifications"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionSplit" name="Produce base model and customized parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceBaseAirplane" name="Produce standard base model"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to manufacturing teams" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveParts" name="Receive manufactured parts" messageRef="Message_Parts"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_AssemblyJoin" name="Base model and parts ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble airplane interior"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TestSplit" name="Conduct test flight and create protocol during flight"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestFlight" name="Conduct test flight"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateTestProtocol" name="Create test protocol during flight"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TestJoin" name="Test flight and protocol complete"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTestProtocol" name="Send test protocol to customer and manufacturer" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DeliverAirplane" name="Deliver airplane" messageRef="Message_Airplane"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive delivery confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Manufacturer" name="Delivery confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturer_1" sourceRef="Start_ReceiveSpecifications" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturer_2" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit" targetRef="Task_ProduceBaseAirplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturer_3" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit" targetRef="Task_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturer_4" sourceRef="Task_ProduceBaseAirplane" targetRef="Gateway_AssemblyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturer_5" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturer_6" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveParts" targetRef="Gateway_AssemblyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturer_7" sourceRef="Gateway_AssemblyJoin" targetRef="Task_AssembleInterior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturer_8" sourceRef="Task_AssembleInterior" targetRef="Gateway_TestSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturer_9" sourceRef="Gateway_TestSplit" targetRef="Task_TestFlight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturer_10" sourceRef="Gateway_TestSplit" targetRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturer_11" sourceRef="Task_TestFlight" targetRef="Gateway_TestJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturer_12" sourceRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol" targetRef="Gateway_TestJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturer_13" sourceRef="Gateway_TestJoin" targetRef="Task_SendTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturer_14" sourceRef="Task_SendTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_DeliverAirplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturer_15" sourceRef="Task_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturer_16" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="End_Manufacturer"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
